children: Ankam, Inc. reported third-quarter 2026 results showing no revenue and a larger net loss versus the year-ago quarter. Revenue was $0 for 3Q 2026 (unchanged from 3Q 2025), net loss widened to $(112,764) versus $(60,551) in the prior-year quarter, and diluted EPS was $(0.02) versus $(0.01) a year earlier.
Revenue was $0 for 3Q 2026, unchanged from $0 in 3Q 2025.
Net income (loss) was $(112,764) for 3Q 2026, versus a $(60,551) loss in 3Q 2025.
Diluted EPS was $(0.02) for 3Q 2026, compared with $(0.01) in 3Q 2025.
Revenue trend: Year-to-date revenue declined sharply, from $240K for the first nine months of 2025 to $44.9K for the first nine months of 2026, indicating reduced sales activity.

Product portfolio: The company operates Expense Minder and MoneySaverApp and completed the acquisition of Apex currency converter; management is pursuing development and cross-promotion among these apps.
Market expansion: Established Mei Sheng Corporation Limited to target Asian markets including Hong Kong and Taiwan, and signed a Taiwan development contract for a health products platform.
Operations: Continued R&D and app development efforts with capitalized software assets; server costs remain a recurring operating expense.
Leadership and structure: Ownership changed in August 2024 with new management and formation of subsidiaries to support regional growth initiatives.
